mechanism: Both drugs have anticholinergic properties and CNS depressant effects; haloperidol may inhibit CYP2D6 metabolism of nortriptyline, increasing tricyclic levels and toxicity risk.
action: Monitor for anticholinergic toxicity, cardiac arrhythmias, and CNS depression; consider dose reduction of nortriptyline; obtain baseline and periodic ECGs to assess QT prolongation.
